summary_zh: 非自回归决策引擎，可在单次前向传播中对任意文本做类型化选择、评分和是/否判断，支持100多种语言，并由路由器为每次请求选择合适检查点；还提供命令行、HTTP/MCP服务及LangChain等集成。
audience_zh: 适合需要在100多种语言文本上快速做分类、打分和是非判断的开发者，例如工单分诊、邮件处理、内容审核等场景；支持Python 3.10+，另有TypeScript/Node版本可选。

evidence.quote: Non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine. Typed choice, score and yes/no decisions over any text in a single forward pass, in 100+ languages, with a router that picks the right checkpoint per request.

**Multilingual, non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine.** Typed decisions over 100+ languages in a single forward pass — 33 ms — trained with reinforcement learning against strictly proper scoring rules (RLCD), with a router that picks the right checkpoint per request.

Python 3.10 or newer. Optional extras: `laya[serve]` (HTTP server), `laya[mcp]` (MCP server), `laya[langchain]` (LangChain and LangGraph), `laya[llamaindex]` (LlamaIndex selectors), `laya[crewai]` (CrewAI routing), `laya[onnx]` (ONNX Runtime), `laya[fast]` (TileLang GPU fast path), `laya[structured]
